name: Automation Hub — Daily Umami Stats & 9:16 Reels Pipeline

parameters.jsCode:
const statsJson = $input.first().json.stdout || '[]';
let umamiStats = [];
try { umamiStats = JSON.parse(statsJson); } catch (e) {}

const weeklySchedule = [
  {
    day: 'SUNDAY',
    saint: 'ST. AUGUSTINE OF HIPPO',
    year: 'Stop #1 of 6  |  Year 354 AD',
    img: 'augustine_step1_thagaste_olive_1794701798229.jpg',
    audio: 'stop_1_clue.mp3',
    slug: 'sun_augustine_reel',
    clueLine1: 'Born in this North African Roman town in modern',
    clueLine2: 'Souk Ahras, Algeria, where Monica prayed for him.',
    clue2: 'Situated in the fertile hills of Numidia before he sailed to Carthage and Milan.',
    storyHook: 'Before becoming one of the greatest minds in Christian history, young Augustine was restless and chasing ambition across the Roman Empire.',
    ytTitle: 'Year 354 AD: Where Did St. Augustine Begin His Journey? 🌍 | Sacred Trails #Shorts',
    hashtags: '#StAugustine #CatholicHistory #SacredTrails #ChristianHistory #GeographyMystery #Shorts'
  },
  {
    day: 'MONDAY',
    saint: 'ST. THOMAS THE APOSTLE',
    year: 'Stop #1 of 6  |  Year 33 AD',
    img: 'thomas_step1_jerusalem.jpg',
    audio: 'thomas_stop_1_clue.mp3',
    slug: 'mon_thomas_reel',
    clueLine1: 'Inside a locked upstairs room on Mount Zion, he',
    clueLine2: 'placed his fingers into the risen Lord wounds.',
    clue2: 'From this ancient walled city, he embarked on the longest journey of any Apostle—all the way to India.',
    storyHook: 'Eight days after Easter, one skeptical Apostle demanded physical proof inside a locked room—before sailing further East than any other disciple.',
    ytTitle: 'Year 33 AD: Where Did St. Thomas Begin His 5,000-Mile Trail? 🌍 | Sacred Trails #Shorts',
    hashtags: '#StThomas #ApostleThomas #CatholicHistory #SacredTrails #AncientHistory #Shorts'
  },
  {
    day: 'TUESDAY',
    saint: 'ST. FRANCIS XAVIER',
    year: 'Stop #1 of 6  |  Year 1506 AD',
    img: 'xavier_step1_javier.jpg',
    audio: 'xavier_stop_1_clue.mp3',
    slug: 'tue_xavier_reel',
    clueLine1: 'Born inside a partially dismantled stone castle in',
    clueLine2: 'the foothills of the Pyrenees in northern Spain.',
    clue2: 'After Navarre was conquered by Castile in 1512, Cardinal Cisneros ordered this family fortress stripped of its towers.',
    storyHook: 'Before sailing to India, Malacca, and Japan, young Francis Xavier grew up inside a war-torn stone castle in the Pyrenees.',
    ytTitle: 'Year 1506: Can You Find St. Francis Xavier Birthplace Castle? 🌍 | #Shorts',
    hashtags: '#StFrancisXavier #Jesuits #CatholicHistory #SacredTrails #HistoryMystery #Shorts'
  },
  {
    day: 'WEDNESDAY',
    saint: 'ST. PAUL THE APOSTLE',
    year: 'Stop #1 of 6  |  Year 34 AD',
    img: 'paul_step1_damascus.jpg',
    audio: 'paul_stop_1_clue.mp3',
    slug: 'wed_paul_reel',
    clueLine1: 'Blinded by a heavenly light at midday, he was led',
    clueLine2: 'along the ancient Roman boulevard called Straight Street.',
    clue2: 'Ananias restored his sight inside one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities on Earth.',
    storyHook: 'Breathing threats and carrying arrest warrants, Saul of Tarsus rode toward an ancient walled city—until a blinding light stopped him cold.',
    ytTitle: 'Year 34 AD: Can You Find Straight Street on the 3D Globe? 🌍 | St. Paul #Shorts',
    hashtags: '#StPaul #BibleHistory #CatholicHistory #SacredTrails #BiblicalGeography #Shorts'
  },
  {
    day: 'THURSDAY',
    saint: 'ST. FRANCIS OF ASSISI',
    year: 'Stop #1 of 6  |  Year 1205 AD',
    img: 'francis_step1_assisi.jpg',
    audio: 'francis_stop_1_clue.mp3',
    slug: 'thu_francis_reel',
    clueLine1: 'Praying before a painted Byzantine cross in a crumbling',
    clueLine2: 'hillside chapel, he heard: Rebuild My Church.',
    clue2: 'Later became the home of St. Clare and the first Poor Clares in Umbria, Italy.',
    storyHook: 'A wealthy silk merchant son walked into a ruined stone chapel in 1205—and heard a voice from the Crucifix that changed his life forever.',
    ytTitle: 'Year 1205: Which Ruined Chapel Spoke to St. Francis? 🌍 | Sacred Trails #Shorts',
    hashtags: '#StFrancisOfAssisi #CatholicHistory #SacredTrails #Umbria #ChristianHistory #Shorts'
  },
  {
    day: 'FRIDAY',
    saint: 'ST. IGNATIUS OF LOYOLA',
    year: 'Stop #1 of 6  |  Year 1521 AD',
    img: 'ignatius_step1_loyola.jpg',
    audio: 'ignatius_stop_1_clue.mp3',
    slug: 'fri_ignatius_reel',
    clueLine1: 'Wounded by a cannonball in 1521, he recovered inside',
    clueLine2: 'his family tower house in the green Basque valley.',
    clue2: 'Asking for chivalric romances to pass the time, he was given only the Life of Christ and Lives of the Saints.',
    storyHook: 'After a cannonball shattered his leg in 1521, a proud Spanish knight was carried home to a Basque tower house—where two books changed his soul.',
    ytTitle: 'Year 1521: Inside Which Basque Castle Did Ignatius Convert? 🌍 | #Shorts',
    hashtags: '#StIgnatius #Jesuits #CatholicHistory #SacredTrails #SpanishHistory #Shorts'
  },
  {
    day: 'SATURDAY',
    saint: 'ST. JOAN OF ARC',
    year: 'Stop #1 of 6  |  Year 1425 AD',
    img: 'joan_step1_domremy.jpg',
    audio: 'joan_stop_1_clue.mp3',
    slug: 'sat_joan_reel',
    clueLine1: 'At age 13, she first heard St. Michael and St. Catherine',
    clueLine2: 'in her father garden beside the Meuse River.',
    clue2: 'A quiet village on the border of Champagne and Lorraine in northeastern France.',
    storyHook: 'In the summer of 1425, while France was torn apart by the Hundred Years War, a 13-year-old peasant girl heard voices in her village garden.',
    ytTitle: 'Year 1425: Where Did 13-Year-Old Joan of Arc Hear the Voices? 🌍 | #Shorts',
    hashtags: '#StJoanOfArc #JoanOfArc #CatholicHistory #SacredTrails #MedievalHistory #Shorts'
  }
];

const dow = new Date().getDay();
const today = weeklySchedule[dow];
const baseDir = '/data/automation-hub/projects/divinepilgrim/assets';

const cmd = [
  '/data/automation-hub/shared-tools/generate-reel.sh',
  '"' + baseDir + '/images/trails/' + today.img + '"',
  '"' + baseDir + '/audio/narration/' + today.audio + '"',
  '"' + baseDir + '/audio/gregorian_chant.mp3"',
  '"SACRED TRAILS  |  ' + today.day + ' MYSTERY"',
  '"' + today.saint + '"',
  '"' + today.year + '"',
  '"' + today.clueLine1 + '"',
  '"' + today.clueLine2 + '"',
  '"Play Free at DivinePilgrim.com"',
  '"' + today.slug + '"'
].join(' ');

const socialCaption = [
  today.storyHook,
  '',
  '🔍 TODAY\'S MYSTERY CLUE #1:',
  '"' + today.clueLine1 + ' ' + today.clueLine2 + '"',
  '',
  '💬 Drop your city guess in the comments below!',
  '🌍 Solve all 6 stops on the interactive 3D Globe (free, no login):',
  '👉 https://divinepilgrim.com/sacred-trails',
  '',
  today.hashtags
].join('\n');

const pinnedComment = '💡 Need a 2nd hint? CLUE #2: ' + today.clue2 + ' — Test your guess on the 3D Globe at https://divinepilgrim.com/sacred-trails 🌍';

return [{
  json: {
    dayOfWeek: today.day,
    saint: today.saint,
    reelSlug: today.slug,
    renderCommand: cmd,
    socialContext: {
      youtubeTitle: today.ytTitle,
      youtubeAndInstagramCaption: socialCaption,
      firstPinnedComment: pinnedComment,
      targetUrl: 'https://divinepilgrim.com/sacred-trails'
    },
    umamiAnalytics: umamiStats
  }
}];
